fusions.name: Barbed Snag
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away along a barbed strand, then deals 11 damage and holds it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaffed Haul
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed strand that deals 20 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. It can only strike a target at or below 25% health. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Long Line
fusions.desc: Your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
